errors.evidence: The description identifies each line by its color but fails to state what product category each line represents according to the legend (e.g., 'All products', 'Natural gas', 'Solid fossil fuels', 'Oil and petroleum products').
The blue line ('All products') starts at approximately 58% in 2008, not 55%.
The description incorrectly states that the red line is thick ('дебела линия'). In the figure, only the dark blue line is thick; the red line has a standard thickness.
The red line does not decrease to 33% in 2011. Its lowest point is around 36% in 2009. In 2011, its value is approximately 40%.
The final value for the red line in 2018 is closer to 43%, not 41%.
The description incorrectly states that the purple line is thick ('дебела линия'). This line has a standard thickness.
The purple line ('Natural gas') starts at 70% in 2008, not 65%.
The phrase 'decreases to 72%' ('намалява до 72%') is contradictory and nonsensical, as the starting value was reported as 65% (and the actual value was 70%). The value does not decrease.

errors.evidence: This range is incorrect. The purple line starts at 70%, dips to about 68% in 2010, and then rises steadily to approximately 83% in 2018. The range is much wider than described.
The description incorrectly states that the light blue line is thick ('дебела линия'). This line has a standard thickness.

errors.evidence: All numerical values reported for the light blue line are completely wrong. This line ('Oil and petroleum products') stays consistently high, starting at ~94% in 2008 and ending at ~94% in 2018. The reported values (55%, 59%, 56%) seem to be a misreading of the dark blue 'All products' line.
